claims.source_quote_ar: بَدَلٌ مِنْ وَاحِدٍ، أَوْ خَبَرُ مُبْتَدَأٍ مَحْذُوفٍ، أَيْ هُوَ رَبُّ.
claims.claim_ar: اسم «رَبّ» يمكن إعرابه بوجهين: بدل من واحد أو خبر لمبتدأ محذوف.
claims.claim_en: The noun 'rabb' can be analyzed in two ways: as a badal (substitute) from 'one' or as the predicate (khabar) of an omitted subject.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited statement in al-Tibyan discusses the phrase «رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ…»; applying the same two alternative analyses to «بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» requires checking the effect of the preposition «بِ».

claims.claim_ar: يجوز تقدير «هي» لبيان أن المضاف إليه يكون مرفوعًا أو خبرًا (مثال: «زِينَتُهَا الْكَوَاكِبُ» → تقدير «هي»).
claims.claim_en: It is possible to supply an implied 'hiya' ('it is') so that the second term is read as nominative/predicate (e.g., 'its adornment is the stars' with an implied 'it is').
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted example in al-Tibyan concerns a different phrase («بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ»); extending the permissibility of a تقدير («هي») to «بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» is plausible but should be verified in context (presence of preposition may affect the reconstruction).

claims.claim_ar: قد تُقرأ العبارة بصيغة الإضافة (أي قراءة بدون حرف الباء)، كخيار قرائي يؤثر على الإعراب.
claims.claim_en: The phrase may be read as an idafa (i.e., read without the preposition 'bi-'), a lectal option that would affect the syntactic parsing.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source example (about «زِينَةِ الْكَوَاكِبِ») illustrates the general possibility of reading with idafa; whether that lectal choice applies to this specific ayah should be confirmed from qira'at and context.

warnings: The extracted claims are based on general principles and examples cited in the provided al-Tibyan chunks (examples: «رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ…», «بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ»). Those examples are not the exact verse under study; applicability to S37:87 (which contains the preposition «بِ») should be verified against context, classical commentaries on this specific verse, and qira'at authorities.
